basis: YAAM source inspection versus official OpsLog documentation fetched on the audit date. No comparative runtime, hardware, account or performance test. Public OpsLog release tag contains README/workflow material, not application implementation.

new_work_items.title: DXCC Challenge: exclude 60 m and make the counted band set explicit
new_work_items.finding: Confirmed source logic defect; no production log or Swift runtime exercised.

evidence.description: The Challenge list includes 60m; dxccChallengePoints sums every listed band.
Awards UI consumes this computed total.

scope: Use the ten Challenge bands defined by ARRL; keep general logbook/QRZ 60 m statistics independent.
Show counted bands and whether the total is a local confirmation estimate or official accepted credit.
Audit deleted entities, date eligibility and proof-source policy separately under #96; do not erase QSOs.
checks: One entity confirmed on 20 m and 60 m yields one Challenge point; a 60 m-only entity yields zero.
Cover all ten eligible bands, duplicate contacts, mixed-case bands and absent BAND derived from FREQ.
Verify the total agrees in every UI consuming the matrix.
new_work_items.depends: Related #96. Normative reference: https://www.arrl.org/dxcc-challenge/ and https://www.arrl.org/dxcc-rules .

new_work_items.title: Logbook: arbitrary-field Boolean filters and independent named presets
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: rich fixed filters and some search alternatives exist; general field/operator/AND/OR builder is absent.

evidence.description: Fixed criteria structure rather than a general predicate tree.
Filters can be loaded from email templates; this is not independent general preset management.
Filtered ADIF/CSV export already exists and must be reused.

scope: Add typed field/operator/value predicates, ALL/ANY groups, empty/not-empty and numeric/date comparisons.
Save, rename, duplicate and delete named presets independently of email templates and scoped to station.
Apply one predicate to the complete active log, visible count, selection and filtered export.
checks: Evaluate a band/mode condition combined with OR across two provider-status fields.
Cover unknown APP fields, Unicode, empty values and UTC boundaries.
Place a matching QSO beyond the first displayed page; count and export must still include it.

new_work_items.title: DXCC: dated Club Log exceptions and reviewed historical re-resolution
new_work_items.finding: Current CTY support exists; the inspected resolver accepts callsign without QSO date and no dated exception layer was found.

evidence.description: Current call/prefix resolver has no QSO-date input.
There is also a static prefix resolver; consumers need a consistent policy.

scope: Introduce versioned date-ranged exceptions with source, freshness and provenance; obtain provider permission/terms before automated retrieval.
Resolve using callsign plus QSO UTC date and preserve explicit historical/deleted-entity identity by default.
Provide a selected/filtered bulk preview with old/new fields and conflict decisions before transactional application.
checks: Same callsign in two independently sourced date windows resolves to different entities.
Test date edges, /MM, /AM, guest prefixes, deleted entity preservation and manual overrides.
Updating CTY must not undo a dated exception; export/reload keeps approved identity.
new_work_items.depends: Coordinate #83 and #318; these cover stamping/grouping rather than dated resolution. Reuse import review and backup paths.

new_work_items.title: Station profiles: isolate CAT, audio, cluster and workspace operating settings
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: station identity, log separation and some credentials are scoped; inspected CAT/TCI/rotator settings use global keys.

evidence.description: Profile stores identity/equipment description, not a complete operating configuration.
CAT configuration persists globally.
TCI endpoint is global.
Profile switch reloads log and QSL state; equipment settings need an explicit switch transaction.

scope: Add per-profile CAT, audio routes/levels, cluster, rotator and layout snapshots with migration from current defaults.
Make account-wide versus station-specific settings visible; retain existing credential-vault boundaries.
Switch only when transmit is idle; disconnect/reconnect intentionally and prevent callbacks from the old station changing the new one.
checks: Home and portable profiles retain different rig endpoints, audio devices, cluster and workspace after restart.
No auto-keying or command reaches the previous radio on a station switch.
Credentials and QSO ownership remain isolated; migration can be rolled back.
new_work_items.depends: Related #149; this card is equipment/settings scope, not shared multi-op storage.

new_work_items.title: Awards: user-defined rules, reference catalogues and explainable matching
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: built-in awards, WAZ/WPX/Challenge views and lifecycle claims exist; no user-editable award rule system was found.

evidence.description: Local award definitions are compiled in source.
WPX already exists in another award path; do not list it as missing.

scope: Define award scope, date/band/mode restrictions, reference field, unique-count rule and accepted proof sources as versioned data.
Import/export personal reference lists and definitions with attribution; support an initial simple national/club award without rebuilding YAAM.
Provide a per-QSO explanation and explicit manual-reference override; preserve it through ADIF via a documented APP field.
Treat RDA date-aware data, DDFM and counties as later catalogue work after licensing review; do not infer a district from present-day lookup.
checks: Create and round-trip a small club award and a date-limited national award.
Test missing reference, ambiguous match, rejected proof source and duplicate band/mode slots.
Local worked/confirmed/credited/submitted/granted states remain distinct.
new_work_items.depends: Reuse and coordinate #96, #1 and #265. Do not create a parallel awards counter.

new_work_items.title: ADIF: versioned field dictionary, validation and explicit export field selection
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: arbitrary fields round-trip and selected/filtered exports exist; UI labels ADIF 3.1.4 and no complete versioned dictionary/picker was found. This does not establish loss of all newer tags.

evidence.description: Current advertised version is 3.1.4.
Parser keeps generic fields.
Selected-row export already exists.

scope: Audit actual 3.1.7 field/types/enumerations support against the official specification before changing the version claim.
Provide reusable per-export field selection with standard, APP/unknown and all-fields groups; keep local export distinct from upload-privacy policy.
Show validation warnings and source-field mapping previews without discarding unrecognized values.
Unify mode/submode and SAT_NAME vocabularies used in editable log fields; allow a documented station-specific catalogue.
checks: Round-trip Unicode, unknown APP fields, new official fields, split TX/RX frequencies and satellite name.
Selected versus filtered export obeys the same field preset and reports the row count.
Provider-specific uploads retain existing allowlists and consent behavior.

new_work_items.title: Multi-operator: shared live log, conflict handling and on-air presence
new_work_items.finding: Absent workflow in inspected YAAM: SQLite/profile logs and file/cloud merging exist; these are not a concurrent shared station log.

evidence.description: Canonical storage is local SQLite.
Current cross-device mechanism exchanges packages, not concurrent writes.

scope: Design one authoritative shared station service with individual operator identity, durable local outbox and idempotent replay. MySQL is a competitor example, not a required backend.
Define simultaneous edits, deletes, serial allocation and duplicate decisions before implementation.
Show per-operator band/mode/frequency with freshness and off-air state; expose optional read-only published status separately.
checks: Two isolated clients log concurrently; both see contacts without duplicate replay.
Outage/restart/rejoin preserves unsent contacts and surfaces conflicting edits.
Expired presence cannot look live; user controls any public station-status publication.
new_work_items.depends: Related #149; distinct from separate logs per operator/place. Depends on OG-04 and durable-save boundaries. Discovery first; no delivery date.

new_work_items.title: Station accessories: model-specific amplifier, tuner and antenna-switch control
new_work_items.finding: No accessory manager/drivers for the documented competitor families were found; YAAM rotctld control already exists.

evidence.description: Existing rotator path is a Hamlib rotctld client, not an amplifier/tuner/switch subsystem.
No station-accessory destination in the current tool catalogue.

scope: Start with one owner-selected, available hardware model and a capability-based interface; separate read-only telemetry from explicit control.
Roadmap candidates: amplifier operate/standby/faults, tuner bypass/tune, antenna switch mapping and accurate MY_ANTENNA capture.
Consider native ARCO/Rotator Genius/PstRotator and SteppIR/Ultrabeam adapters after the initial device; keep mechanical and radiating bearing distinct.
Do not switch accessories during TX; unsupported controls remain disabled and stale readings are labelled.
checks: Protocol fixtures for the selected model cover truncation, faults, timeout and unsupported controls.
Physical acceptance records model, firmware and transport; no simulator result claims hardware readiness.
Changing band does not actuate a relay until that mapping is explicitly enabled.
new_work_items.depends: Related #260 and #103. Split model implementations after hardware selection; XL describes the full family, not the first read-only milestone.

new_work_items.title: Satellites: validated pass prediction, Doppler CAT and az/el tracking workflow
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: map/pass/Doppler estimates exist; no path from satellite telemetry into radio tuning or rotator tracking was found.

evidence.description: Current engine publishes estimated telemetry.
Current orbital implementation needs validation against a trusted propagator.
Independent rotator control exists but is not a satellite tracking session.

scope: First validate orbit/range-rate and TLE freshness against reference vectors; Doppler must use slant range, not only ground distance.
Add an explicit armed session with uplink/downlink plan, inversion, dual-VFO or two-radio capabilities and bounded command rate.
Link az/el tracking and stop/park behavior to the session; preserve manual override and never key TX merely by tracking.
Populate PROP_MODE, SAT_NAME, BAND_RX and FREQ_RX from reviewed real session data.
checks: Reference passes include low elevation, zenith, stale TLE and horizon boundaries.
Recorded commands track both frequencies and az/el; stop/disconnect prevents further writes.
No PTT in prediction-only mode; hardware acceptance follows deterministic fixtures.
new_work_items.depends: Depends on validated radio capability paths (#103/#260) and profile isolation OG-04.

new_work_items.title: Directed nets: persistent rosters, check-ins and reviewed group logging
new_work_items.finding: No directed-net session/roster workflow found; digital Call Roster, club membership and SKED are different existing tools.

evidence.description: No net-control destination in the current navigation catalogue.
Existing QSO save path can inform integration; do not write directly around persistence.

scope: Add reusable net rosters and persistent sessions with checked-in/on-air/finished states and individual UTC intervals.
Review one or all completed contacts before saving through the normal durable log path.
Label CAT freshness and permit explicit manual frequency; do not silently reuse stale values.
Restore unfinished sessions after restart rather than reproducing the competitor in-memory limitation.
checks: Check in three stations, edit one, log once and restart; unfinished members remain available.
Retrying group save does not duplicate already-saved QSOs.
CAT unavailable and UTC midnight boundaries are explicit and tested.

new_work_items.title: Logbook audio: rolling RX/mic recording linked to individual QSOs
new_work_items.finding: No general per-QSO RX/mic rolling capture and playback attachment workflow found; WebSDR timelines and digital ADIF archives are different features.

evidence.description: Existing receive timeline is a useful adjacent component, not a generic logbook attachment service.
Digital archive is ADIF, not an audio attachment store.

scope: Opt-in bounded rolling recording with pre-roll, correct RX/mic routes and per-QSO attachment metadata.
Offer local playback from the log row; select retention/storage location and preserve attached recordings when trimming unrelated buffers.
Link files only after durable QSO save, with visible missing-file and interrupted-capture states.
Keep recordings local unless the operator separately exports them; on-air replay is outside this card.
checks: Two adjacent contacts retain the correct pre-roll/time window and stable attachments after reload.
Disk full, missing input and crash leave recoverable audio and a truthful status.
Retention cannot remove a recording pinned to a saved QSO.

new_work_items.title: Voice keyer: recorded messages with reviewed audio/PTT routing
new_work_items.finding: No general voice-message recording/playback keyer found in YAAM source/navigation; related Voice Keyer cards on the board belong to Lab599 or Xiegu.

evidence.description: Radio tools contain digital/CW paths but no voice-keyer workflow.
Reuse the existing audio/transmit boundaries rather than inventing an independent PTT path.

scope: Record/import a small set of phone-mode messages with local audition, explicit microphone/radio output selection and level control.
Integrate function keys and a single interruptible playback session with existing transmit limits and shutdown behavior.
Phone-mode checks, explicit arming, STOP and actual PTT receipts are required; Auto-CQ is an optional later milestone with finite repeats.
checks: Local audition never keys PTT; disconnected/wrong output and non-phone modes refuse with a reason.
STOP, sleep, disconnect and route change terminate playback and request release.
Physical receive/PTT/audio-level acceptance is recorded for one supported radio.
new_work_items.depends: Depends on shared TX controls (#3/#4/#10/#103); coordinate cross-app reusable components #141.

new_work_items.title: TCI: binary network audio routes for receive, recording and digital output
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: TCI control/CW/spots exist; binary messages are only attempted as UTF-8 command text, with no binary audio decoder route found.

evidence.description: Binary WebSocket messages are not parsed as typed TCI audio packets.
Existing control client and transmit ownership must be reused.

scope: Parse versioned TCI binary audio framing and expose a named network RX source with bounded buffering and format diagnostics.
Integrate RX with recording/digital input first; add TX audio as a separate armed milestone with explicit stream ownership.
Keep receiver/channel/sample-rate mapping and source-of-audio state visible; never switch the radio microphone source implicitly.
checks: Independent protocol fixtures cover frame types, sizes, channels, sample rates and malformed input.
RX decoding/recording works without a virtual cable and cannot key TX.
TX stop/disconnect/underflow and physical loopback acceptance preserve existing release controls.
new_work_items.depends: Related OG-11/OG-12 and #103. Confirm actual TCI protocol/server capabilities before implementation.

new_work_items.title: QSL cards: reusable user-designed photo templates per station
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: QSL rendering/email/export and paper-label designer exist; current full card uses the EP2AES PDF or a fallback layout, without a free photo-template editor.

evidence.description: Current renderer selects a special personal template.
Other calls use a fixed fallback.
Printable label settings already exist and must not be called missing.

scope: Add reusable per-profile photo/card templates with editable text/image/QSO blocks, fonts, preview and local asset copies.
Support arbitrary station callsigns and multiple templates; keep current personal card available.
Optional automatic layout proposals can follow a usable manual editor; PDF/PNG export and existing mail review are reused.
checks: Create two station templates, move the original photos and reload without losing assets.
Long/portable callsigns, Unicode names and missing QSO fields render legibly.
Preview/export use the selected station identity and never imply a confirmation not present in the log.
new_work_items.depends: Coordinate #261 (existing personal card), #295 (truthful confirmation text) and #308 (designer guidance).

new_work_items.title: DX alerts: spotter filters, band/mode cells and optional email delivery
new_work_items.finding: Partial capability: five editable rule slots, sound/system notifications and call/entity/band/mode conditions exist; spotter predicates, exact band×mode choices and email action are absent from the inspected model.

evidence.description: Current rule fields lack spotter filters and email actions.
Evaluation/delivery currently lives in the cluster view.

scope: Extend the existing rule engine with spotter call/country/continent and selected band×mode cells.
Move evaluation to an appropriately owned service so navigation does not define whether a rule is active.
Offer explicitly enabled SMTP alerts with test/preview, cooldown, quiet periods, deduplication and station-scoped recipients.
Allow independently named rules rather than a fixed five-slot product limit if operator need is confirmed.
checks: A rule for 20 m digital OR 40 m phone never fires on the two unwanted cross combinations.
Repeated multi-node spots produce one alert per configured interval; spotter restrictions work.
Changing views/restarting preserves rule behavior; email disabled or empty recipient sends nothing.
new_work_items.depends: Coordinate #311 (digital first-call alerts), #443 and #444; preserve current sound and notification settings.

new_work_items.title: Remote station: paired operator console with capability and audio negotiation
new_work_items.finding: Partial adjacent pieces: Icom network client, rigctld/TCI clients and a mobile companion exist; no general YAAM-to-YAAM physical-station host/client workflow was found.

evidence.description: The network server path controls synthetic state, not a paired physical station.
Existing direct Icom network support is not absent and should be preserved.
File/cloud log exchange is not remote station audio/control.

scope: Begin with an architecture and threat/latency/capability review for an operator console paired with a station host; do not expose the unauthenticated emulator to a network.
Use authenticated encrypted transport or a clearly documented private-tunnel model, single-controller leases and host-side transmit limits.
Negotiate radio controls and RX/TX audio independently, starting read-only/RX and disabling unsupported controls.
Make local station intervention, stale telemetry, takeover and disconnect recovery explicit.
checks: An unpaired client cannot read/control/stream; replayed/expired control leases are refused.
Link loss, audio stall, reconnect and local override cannot leave a hidden TX state.
End-to-end latency and physical-radio acceptance are documented separately from emulator fixtures.
new_work_items.depends: Depends on #10/#103/#3 and OG-04/OG-13; not a prerequisite for everyday local logging. Discovery first.
